_about: WORLD 12, 11/7 (VAMILY rule 426(e), ask line 496; it replaces WORLD 11's carcass of 11/6, which Paolo voted NO: 'you're not simplifying... I just want easy, quick interaction... maybe they end up in our storage... the shopping cart was an example and you ran with it'). A won fight with beasts leaves the kill on the map beside the fight; ONE tap puts its meat in the company's food (two nights a man) and its hide in the stash as a roll of ECONOMY's HIDES; no vultures (rule 431). No cart, no plate, no clock on the screen, no new screen. Read by slices/bohemia_carcass.js; a modder edits the numbers here.

meat_share.about: the share of a beast's live weight that is meat a person eats, after the hide, the bones, the guts and the head
meat_share.source: about half a carcass is meat (records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_THE_CARCASS_HAUL_IT_TELL_IT_OR_LEAVE_IT_11_4_26.md); a field-dressed deer gives about 40 percent of its live weight

kg_a_night.about: a man's night of food is half a kilo of meat
kg_a_night.source: a working adult eats about half a kilo of meat a day when meat is the meal (WORLD 11's floor)

nights_a_man.about: the most a kill puts in the company's food: two nights a man, what the company eats before it turns in the Mojave heat; the rest is left
nights_a_man.source: food left out above 32 C is unsafe after an hour (USDA); cooked and smoked over a fire it keeps a couple of days; draft, TUNING's to set

hide.about: the kill's hide is ECONOMY's own trade good HIDES (records/target/bb/stall_prices.json trade, Battle Brothers' Furs, base worth 300 -> 30), one roll a kill, made by ECONOMY's tradeItem: every stall buys it at the town's price, the map marks where it sells best (rule 425(b))

keep_h.about: game hours a kill nobody takes lies on the map; then the birds have had it and it is gone, quietly (no clock is shown)
keep_h.source: food left out above 32 C is unsafe after an hour (USDA); a carcass in the Mojave sun is to the bone in about two days

vultures.about: rule 431(a)(f) (Paolo 11/7: 'there's too many vultures on screen on the map. They don't even look like vultures... just another animal we can fight'): nothing circles a kill and nothing follows him; the vulture is a beast he meets and fights (the teratorn), never a map sign. The map's cap (records/target/bb/map_ambient.json) holds 'vulture' at 0.

kinds._about: keyed by the fight's own enemy id; 'faction' is the map's beast party; 'label' is the animal's name; 'kg' is the live weight (the meat is 45 in 100 of it)

american_lion.label: AMERICAN LION
american_lion.source: Panthera atrox, 250 to 350 kg (rule 392's own floor; rule 345)

mountain_lion.label: LION
mountain_lion.source: a male mountain lion, 60 to 70 kg (rule 392's own floor)

ground_sloth.label: GROUND SLOTH
ground_sloth.source: the Shasta ground sloth of Gypsum Cave (Nothrotheriops shastensis), about 250 kg

camelops.label: CAMEL
camelops.source: Camelops hesternus, about 800 kg (Tule Springs' own camel)

ancient_bison.label: BISON
ancient_bison.source: Bison antiquus, about a quarter bigger than a modern bull (900 kg)

feral_bull.label: BULL
feral_bull.source: a range bull gone wild, 600 to 900 kg

hyena.label: HYENA
hyena.source: the cave hyena (Crocuta spelaea), up to about 100 kg

wardog.label: DOG
wardog.source: a shepherd-sized feral dog, about 30 to 35 kg

warhound.label: DOG
warhound.source: a big guard dog, about 40 kg

default.label: BEAST
default.source: a fall-back for a beast this file does not name yet

by_faction._about: when the fight could not say which animal died, the map's party names it
